title: Tuning: 1x8 LSTM, dropout 0.3, learning rate 0.001
description: Hyperparameter search on the window-study reference (200 ms, active torque, causal 2nd-order envelope, purged validation split, no per-angle scaling, batch 64). Chosen by session-1 VALIDATION loss only; the session-2 test is not used for the choice. Training windows are fed in time order (no shuffling).
